trailers.title: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey | Official Trailer | Netflix
trailers.descriptionSummary: Patsy and John Ramsey navigate grief and scrutiny after their daughter's murder — while a flawed investigation unravels amid conflict and media frenzy.
trailers.summary: The series centers on one of the most infamous unsolved murder cases in American history, and the devastating personal and public reckoning that followed the death of JonBenet Ramsey on Christmas night in 1996.

trailers.title: Lil Kev | Season 2 Official Trailer | Paramount+
trailers.descriptionSummary: Lil Kev is back, and the adventures are getting bigger! Inspired by Kevin Hart’s childhood in the ’90s, Season 2 is packed with new shenanigans, special guest stars, and all kinds of mischief.
trailers.summary: Set in 1993 North Philadelphia, follow 12-year-old Kevin Hart, whose wild imagination and unshakable optimism constantly collide with his neighborhood's harsh realities. At the same time, his no-nonsense mother Nancy juggles night shifts as an E.R. nurse while waging a one-woman war to keep Kev on track – no easy feat with his mischievous older brother Robert blazing all the wrong trails, his trainwreck father Henry's outrageous attempts to win Nancy back, and his ex-con uncle Richard Jr.'s questionable life advice.

trailers.title: TIMBERLAKE — Official Trailer | Apple TV
trailers.descriptionSummary: When does TIMBERLAKE premiere? TIMBERLAKE premieres December 11 on Apple TV.
trailers.summary: After 30 years of unparalleled success and relentless scrutiny, Justin Timberlake looks at his life today and reckons with the drama, the headlines, and the cost of never slowing down.

trailers.title: The Trust | Official Trailer | Netflix
trailers.summary: In this reality series, strangers compete to share a quarter of a million dollars. Will they split it evenly — or cut each other out to raise their take?
